entities.name: Uro
entities.description: The most solitary of the titans of Theros, at home on the ocean floor, sealed in the Underworld for eons.

entities.name: Theros
entities.description: Plane where the gods and titans exist.

entities.name: Titans
entities.description: Horrific primal urges made flesh that roamed the mortal realm before the gods.

entities.name: Gods of Theros
entities.description: Gods sprung from mortal devotion who sealed the titans in the Underworld.

entities.name: Klothys
entities.description: God of fate who volunteered to act as jailer, sealing herself in the Underworld to keep the titans trapped.

events.summary: Mortals pray in their hour of need and from their devotion the gods spring forth.
events.quote: From this concentrated devotion , sprang forth the gods themselves.

events.summary: The gods seal the titans away in the Underworld.
events.quote: the gods sealed the titans away in the Underworld

events.summary: Klothys volunteers as jailer, sequestering herself in the Underworld as the eternal seal.
events.quote: volunteered to act as jailer and sequestered herself in the Underworld for eternity

relations.quote: the gods sealed the titans away in the Underworld
Uro is the titan of Nature's Wrath, on the plane of Theros .
